notes.title: The game is back from death!!! Halloween Update with new event!
notes.notes:
Hello, Racers!

For few months I slowly fixed many bugs and phisics leaks.

Inside my little Halloween event you can find:

- Halloween themed track on the hills of Prague with ghost mode, Some Skoda and own Steam Leaderboard to compete with rest of the players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35020966/0073adc077c9b33b7ce81bdc183ab13b574ed712.png

All of this you can find under special button in main menu.
I hope you'll like it. Please leave a review to help other players to find this game.

Don't keep it to yourself!


Do you know someone who is considering buying? Now's a good time to tip him off - the Electro Ride will be available at a 50% discount throughout the Steam Halloween Sale period. You will find a link to share this message just below.

To be a part of Electro Ride Community please join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/5ftEyBN4bv

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Electro Ride BIG #22 update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35020966/b088d279330ec99fad8f26a797dd92c528b5e900.jpg

Sorry for late update I've been very busy with my dayjob release and starting new project.
In this update I use a lot of players feedback and I hope you'll like it:

Improvements:

 updated physics engine
 updated graphics engine - more frames per second and better optimization,
 smaller game size!
 a new model of car braking,
 new handbrake model (more user-friendly),


Fixes:

 track and curve flow repaired,
 steering reaction fixed,
 balance and cornering response and acceleration have been fixed,
 flying cars after a collision have been fixed,


Next update should be ready next month. I'd like to add some competetive improvements and online elements.
And please a leave a review if you've enjoyed the game, it helps me so much!

See you on the roads! 
Sylwester Osik

Photo: @ExusOne from Community Hub

notes.title: Electro Ride BIG #20 update!
notes.notes:
Hello, Racers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35020966/771fdc268082e80e324b1b0b0b0748fa5dc8c059.jpg
Photo-mode screenshot

In this "Big Update" I prepare:

- New "Podium to Win" career mode - now you can unlock new tracks when you are on the podium (win on 1, 2, or 3 race position)
- Leaderboards focused on cars - now you can easly see you are the best driver in this car.

- driftmode balance - you can use handbrake to initialize slide,
- fixed steering input bugs - now steering will be much smoother,
- car handling fixes - faster and better steering cars,
- smoother screenshake - now is lighter and shouldn't drop fps,

- lot of Hud fixes,
- Varna and Warsaw tracks fixes - now you have walls on few dangerous corners,
- Tutorial on new fastest Varna autodrome, not used in story mode,
- AI cars have better paths and speed balance,
- Added special Photo-Mode - now you can pause the game and catch the best moments of your races on photo
- More Optimisation!

The full game is still growing and I'm keeping it updated, now it's the 20th update.
I hope you'll like it. Please leave a review to help other players to find this game.

To be a part of the Electro Ride Community please join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/5ftEyBN4bv

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Electro Ride Release!
notes.notes:
Hello, Racers!

About 10 years ago i bought my first car Fiat 125p.
After 5 years I started to make this game as hobby project for long winter afternoons.
And now... and now i'm releasing Electro Ride, my first commercial project.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35020966/0f1b8374c707f748d7538d2f584100cd8a345a6f.gif

It isn't perfect for me, it isn't fully done. I had to cut and redesing few features but now I'm sure you could love this game as I do.


See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Changelog #2

Hello, Racers!
We getting closer and closer to full release, but still, there is some work to do.

We are very thankful for all reviews and ideas on how we can make Electro Ride better. We are happy to say that, we've made some changes already:

- incrised steering sensitivity
- steering smooth you can off/on in settings 
- little gameplay fixes and optimisation on Berlin tracks
- little fixes in Main menu and Settings
- fixed finish line bug 

It's starting to be heat here, so thanks for taking your part!

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team
